name: Palomides

attributes.attribute: a knight of the Round Table
served king Arthur in the grail quest

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Palomides is an Arthurian hero. He was not British. He was a Saracen, an Islamic fighter. He ranked among the foremost knights of the Round Table. He aided king Arthur in hunting the sacred Grail.

okr.objective: Describe Palomides, a Saracen knight of the Round Table.
key_results: Palomides was a Saracen and one of the greatest Round Table knights.
He served king Arthur in the search for the Grail.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
